reason: The defect is real, and it is worse than filed. In an IN session the equity-overview fan-out for SMR serves SMR Jewels' quote, fundamentals and ratings (SMR.BO) but NuScale's income statement (USD revenue 31.48M FY2025), so one panel shows two companies' numbers with identity_note null. The mechanism is corrected: the sidecar is not region-blind. _RegionMiddleware applies X-Vysted-Region to every route, and with `X-Vysted-Region: US` the same /quotes/SMR and /fundamentals/SMR return NuScale correctly (USD 8.89, ROE -55.18%, 52w 7.21-57.42, which matches the pack). The gap is in the frontend: sidecar-client sends the session-wide settings region on every call, and loadEquityOverview fans out on the bare symbol, dropping the region of the /resolve candidate the user picked. The smallest fix is to pass the picked candidate's region as a per-call header override (sidecarGet already lets per-call headers win) or to key calls by yahoo_symbol, and to make the income/balance/cashflow leg respect that region.
evidence: sidecar/app.py:215-277 (_RegionMiddleware reads x-vysted-region on every HTTP request into config.set_request_region), sidecar/config.py:25-75 (get_region reads that ContextVar, default IN), sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:288-302,448-492 (_effective_region falls back to config.get_region()), sidecar/routers/quotes.py:52-61, sidecar/routers/fundamentals.py:88-110,177-198, src/lib/sidecar-client.ts:154-193 (header = useSettingsStore region; per-call headers override), src/modules/equity-overview/api.ts:101-109 (bare-symbol fan-out, no candidate region), src/lib/symbol-autocomplete.ts:18-23 (candidate carries region + yahoo_symbol that are then dropped)
evidence_checked: Opened the cited routers, provider_registry, config, app.py middleware and the frontend client/fan-out. Repro run against the isolated stack :52152 at 2026-09-23T01:35Z with the region header set to IN and then US.
repro_check: curl -H 'X-Vysted-Region: IN' :52152/quotes/SMR -> bse INR 97.48; /fundamentals/SMR -> 'SMR Jewels Limited' pe 17.47 roe 0.667 identity_note null; /fundamentals/SMR/income -> NuScale USD revenue 31,479,000; /fundamentals/SMR/ratings -> symbol SMR.BO; /resolve?q=SMR -> binds BSE Jewels, NuScale tied at 1.0. With 'X-Vysted-Region: US': /quotes/SMR -> yfinance USD 8.89, /fundamentals/SMR -> 'NuScale Power Corporation' roe -0.5518 52w 57.42/7.21 (matches pack).
